entities.name: Rsp1
observations: Schizosaccharomyces pombe reviewed protein O13601; the submitted 494-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match.
Contains a DnaJ domain (PF00226) at residues 12–75.
Curated function: supports interphase microtubule cytoskeleton organization and equatorial microtubule-organizing center disassembly into satellites.
Curated localization: cytoplasm, nucleus, microtubule bundles, cytoplasmic microtubule plus-end, eMTOC, and spindle pole body.
Interacts with the Hsp70 chaperone Ssa1.
Sequence-derived properties: 494 aa, 56.29 kDa, predicted pI 9.16, net charge at pH 7 approximately +9.3, GRAVY -0.835, instability index 52.3.

entities.name: Ssa1
observations: Hsp70 chaperone reported as an interaction partner of Schizosaccharomyces pombe Rsp1.

entities.name: Microtubule cytoskeleton organization
observations: Rsp1 participates in cytoplasmic microtubule organization and interphase microtubule-organizing-center assembly.
